content:
Apple has launched a brand new accessory browsing and purchasing experience on the Apple Online Store and Apple Store app. After the changes, users can more easily browse accessories by category and view editorial picks.

The changes took effect last week and are available on both the Apple accessories website and the Apple Store app.

The Apple accessories homepage has undergone a comprehensive redesign with a more modern style. Currently, the page offers the following featured category collections:

  • Campus Life
  • Charging Essentials
  • New Colors
  • Travel Must-Haves
  • Work From Home

These categories are expected to be updated throughout the year. The website will also offer recommendations based on the items currently in your shopping bag, and you can browse accessories by product category. You can now also chat live with an Apple Specialist through the accessories website.

In addition to the new design, the revamped Apple accessories experience also includes improved filtering and stronger search functionality. You can still easily distinguish between accessories made by Apple and those made by third-party manufacturers.

You can now visit the Apple website to experience the new Apple accessories page.
